- Marc Manelis

# Marc Manelis, Mayor

Mayor Marc Manelis was appointed to the King City Planning Commission in 2017 and served until January 2022. He then joined the King City Council in January 2022 and was re-elected in November 2022. In January 2025, his fellow councilors selected him to serve as Mayor.

**Regional Assignment:**  
Washington County Coordinating Policy Committee (WCCC)  
League of Oregon Cities - Small Cities Group  
Oregon Mayors Association (OMA)  
Metro Council
